title: Unchanging God
story:
A young boy had a favorite park near his home.

He visited it almost every day.

There was a large tree at the center.

In summer, it gave shade.

In autumn, its leaves fell.

In winter, it looked bare.

In spring, it came alive again.

Everything around him changed.

The weather changed.

The seasons changed.

Even people changed.

But one thing remained the same.

That tree stood firm.

Day after day.

Year after year.

No matter the season.

One day, the boy sat under the tree and thought,

“So many things change… but this tree is always here.”

In life, we experience change all around us.

Situations change.

People change.

Feelings change.

But God never changes.

His love remains the same.

His promises remain true.

His presence remains constant.

When everything feels uncertain,

we can stand firm in Him.

Because He is always the same.
life_lesson:
Everything in life may change, but God never does.

You can always trust His love and His promises.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being constant in my life.

When everything around me changes, You remain the same.

Help me to trust in Your unchanging nature.

Give me peace in uncertain times.

And remind me that Your love never fails.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What changes in your life are making you feel uncertain?

Do you trust that God remains the same?

How can you rely on His promises today?
verse:
I the Lord do not change.
So you, the descendants of Jacob, are not destroyed.
